items.note: Story 1: Larrow Valley Cooperative Creamery Association, 1889, led by Gideon Vose, main creamery at Larrow Green 1891.
Story 1: payment determined solely by the fat test made at Ostrey Hollow, per Article Seven. Covers pay by test rather than weight, and the station's test governing.
Never says that under payment by weight a wrong test would have cost nobody anything.
Only Teague named; Effie Loomis and Hobart Sill absent.
Son of Gideon stated, but no 1913 start in Section A (B3 gives the planted 1911).

Ammon & Sons, Tarnet, invoice 14 April 1897, in service 1 May 1897.

Six farms not stated.

16.27 c.c., short 1.33 (planted NT-1).

Granddaughter.
